method: Static reach analysis of every root *.test.mjs at the baseline commit: imports (resolved through test/support and sibling helpers), repository path literals read, and child-process use; aof/default-application and its service entries count as the assembled application. A file is moved only when everything it reaches is one workspace plus that workspace's declared dependencies, it imports no arch guard or shared root helper, and it reads no repository-level artifact. Verdicts were checked by running each destination workspace's own suite and by comparing the registered case-name multiset (11,537, no duplicates) before and after every batch. Registered names come from importing each file at its current path.

assembledApplicationEvidence.wiring: packages/core/src/application/assemble.mjs builds each namespace from package factories (for example createMeshPresence in @aof/mesh/presence) with collaborators supplied by core bindings under packages/core/src/application/bindings/. Moving one of these suites to a package means constructing that collaborator graph by hand per suite; this ledger records the evidence and leaves the rewrite as an operator decision rather than a mechanical move.
